description: Proposed daycare for 45 children, 10 staff.
Located at 190 and 194 Mazurek Crescent.
Administration recommended denial citing traffic, parking.
Suggested smaller 35-child, 6-staff daycare.

chips.text: Defeated
Commissioner Ryan supported the 45-person daycare for the greater good.
Residents within 150 meters raised concerns about traffic and parking.
Applicant did not state if they would accept a reduced 35-child capacity.
Applicants emphasized the city's high demand for childcare spaces.
Daycare aims to support vulnerable children, newcomers, and those with exceptional needs.
Applicants promised to prioritize Rosewood families for enrollment.
